company.name: Mono
company.shortDescription: Unlocking the potential of Africa's financial system.
company.description: Our mission is to unlock the potential of Africa's financial system by providing businesses with access to the tools and data they need to succeed. From startups to enterprises, our platforms and APIs enable businesses to quickly and securely access financial data, initiate direct bank payments, and verify identity. By opening up access to these crucial resources, we empower companies to thrive and drive economic growth in Africa.

productsAndServices.description: An API-driven platform that enables businesses to securely link customers' financial accounts and access real-time data such as balances, transactions, statements, income, and identity information.
productsAndServices.name: Mono Connect

productsAndServices.description: A payment solution that enables businesses to collect direct bank transfers securely without using debit cards, supporting one-time and recurring payments with zero chargebacks.
productsAndServices.name: Mono DirectPay

productsAndServices.description: A no-code solution for businesses to create customizable payment pages and links to collect direct bank payments securely and quickly.
productsAndServices.name: Mono DirectPay Pages

productsAndServices.description: A service that allows businesses to collect and retrieve customers' bank statements in PDF or JSON formats for up to 12 months, facilitating financial assessment and credit decisions.
productsAndServices.name: Mono Statement Pages and Statements API

productsAndServices.description: An API feature that enables continuous or on-demand synchronization of linked financial accounts to fetch updated transaction and balance data without requiring user re-authentication.
productsAndServices.name: Mono Data Sync

productsAndServices.description: An API service that enables businesses to verify users' Bank Verification Number (BVN) data securely with user consent, complying with regulatory consent requirements.
productsAndServices.name: Mono BVN Lookup

caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
